notes.title: Go behind the scenes with our Kickstarter campaign video!
notes.content:
Faces Behind Copa City

[previewyoutube=8wVs5PHujV0;full][/previewyoutube]

When you play Copa City, you won’t just be building fan zones, managing stadiums, or planning matchday logistics. You’ll be stepping into a world shaped by a humble yet very dedicated team — people who have lived both in the world of football and in the world of games.

In our latest behind-the-scenes video, we open the doors to Triple Espresso. No flashy studios, no corporate gloss — just the place where Copa City is being made, and the people making it. 

From Jakub’s reflections on football as a culture, to Dominik’s first-hand stories from the streets on matchday, to our designers, artists, and engineers talking about the craft and challenge of building a living city event simulation — this is us.

We’re not the biggest team. But we are one that believes in trust, ambition, and maybe a little too much coffee.

And right now, we’re also opening up our Kickstarter pre-campaign. Wishlisting our game here and following us there is free, but it helps more than you might imagine — and seeing that number go up means the world to us.

So, meet the faces behind Copa City. And if you like what you see, hit that “Follow” button on Kickstarter. We’ll take it from there.

Follow Copa City on Kickstarter →

notes.title: Bonuses and Limitations in building: Shape Your City, Strategically!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053691/a8caf46e0134c1fe8db7aff6563f0b877aff35b0.png
Permanent Bonuses from Functional Buildings
We will introduce you to a gameplay element designed to elevate your city-building experience: the "Bonuses and Limitations in building" system! This feature encourages strategic planning and efficient module layouts, adding depth and exciting challenges to managing your grids.

Get ready to be rewarded for your architectural prowess! Functional buildings grant permanent bonuses to entire areas, encouraging skillful use of space and thoughtful planning. These bonuses are activated by functional buildings with a defined range and will affect all modules within that range.

What kind of effects can you expect? These bonuses can modify:

 Module construction costs
 Maintenance costs
 Module operating efficiency
 Your final score


To make this system intuitive, we've integrated clear visual cues on your 3D map. Grids under the influence of a bonus will be marked with an icon assigned to the functional building providing it.

Grid without any bonuses

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053691/ef6d98a09da4d7444070e3f43bf4685b6ddc1db2.png

Grid with one additional bonus from functional building

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053691/5aaabd9a7775447fa68f83e0c24b259ce4b5bfed.png

Grid with two additional bonuses from functional buildings

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053691/348fb60be5cce8bfc3065858badf37ad7b8d269b.png

When you hover over a functional building or a grid, the game will conveniently show the building's range or indicate which building is providing the bonus. Even if the visual suggests a part of the grid is outside the range, the entire grid (all its fields) receives the same bonus. If a grid is influenced by multiple functional buildings, hovering over it will display the ranges of all impacting buildings. The same logic applies to the tactical map for consistent gameplay understanding.

Functional building bonus area range

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053691/cc4e8b45cb80f736c4374e049d008698083ae15e.png

You'll also see all active permanent bonuses on your building panel, either as an icon that reveals information on hover or directly as information plus an icon.

Understanding Limitations: Pathways and Generators
We're introducing two main limitations that will challenge your planning skills and ensure your modules are functioning optimally:
Building Pathways: Modules that require pathways simply won't work without them. Modules that are offline due to a missing pathway will be clearly marked with an icon.

The modules lack a connecting path, as indicated by markers visible above them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053691/053bc617dbc42f1f60dc185177ef3bbf49ae9644.png

Generator Operation on Grids
If a module needs power, it must be placed within the range of an appropriate generator. Each generator has a specific range, providing power to modules within that range. Modules may require a specific type of generator (small, medium, or large). Interestingly, if a module requires a small generator, higher types (medium, large) will also work, but smaller types, even in greater numbers, will not. Some modules, like pathways, don't require a generator at all.

Small and medium generators range

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053691/8bf6d3da55c7e6a7104cea4b0fdc60866a883ffe.png

Large generator range

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053691/aca6a71d0ec3f3d2ad6905eba658a0e7a59501cf.png

To assist your building decisions, when placing a generator, you'll see a preview of its range. If a module requires a generator, the game will show the ranges of all generators that fulfill its energy needs. For example, if you're placing a 'Scene module' that requires a large generator, you'll only see the ranges of large generators. If you're placing a 'Standard Foodtruck module' that requires small generators, you'll see the ranges of all types of generators. The system will also inform you if there are non-functioning modules on a grid due to a lack of a generator in range. Importantly, any module "touching" a generator's range is considered within its range, even if most of the model is outside. Modules will remain offline until a generator is built within their range. The generator's range and any warnings about non-working modules will persist until you address the situation.

Modules are not connected to pathway and generator

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053691/83c5d5d80de0b8b51312e1c46457aacf5309d322.png

Modules properly connected to generator and pathway

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053691/2190b49c2cabcc730ea2acd67429e2d6b701ab43.png
Perhaps some of you noticed that the same screen above showed two generators connected to these modules. As we can see, in this case, just one generator was enough to fully power all visible modules. This simply demonstrates the capabilities offered by this functionality and the potential for optimization and proper planning when building modules.


We truly believe these new systems will add exciting strategic layers to your city-building endeavors. We can't wait to see the incredible zones that you'll create in the cities!

notes.title: How Fans 'Paint' the COPA CITY
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053691/b15abdf7d27d0189eb5db2b8f63923e44124900e.png
🏙️ How Cities Come Alive When Fans Arrive! 🌟 


Today, we will focus on the moment when crowds of fans begin to arrive to COPA CITY. This is an important moment when you will be able to observe the visual effects of your preparations for the football festival.

We are optimizing the visual representation of fans of individual teams in different districts. Our goal is to ensure that a given part of the city pulsates with the colors and spirit of a specific club.

Let's take a look at how it looks in the case of a previously neutral district that changes under the influence of arriving Flamengo fans:

Fanzone and surroundings in neutral COPA CITY colors

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053691/b4640fc731685592741c5cbaf01de4d69fef57a2.jpg

Fanzone and surroundings in Flamengo club colors

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053691/b67c953533b30b8a4c1e2bfa5cb2cfe850cc6af8.jpg

Noticeable changes include:

 The gate in the fanzone adopts club colors
 Ball-shaped balloons adopt club colors
 Cable car wagons and the cable car stations themselves adopt club colors
 Not presented, but will also change colors - banners around the fanzone
 Signs on lampposts will adopt club colors


As you can see, the visual signs of club presence will be numerous, and you will easily be able to recognize which district the fans of a given club are in. Additionally, your cities will be decorated with club banners, making the dominance of a specific team visible from a further camera perspective.

Flamengo banners hanging on buildings

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053691/e464ced07dfaa491b79f018a74d4b521a117da60.jpg

We are constantly adjusting the number of elements so that there are not too many and do not cause unnecessary confusion, while still achieving the intended effect.

We are curious about your opinions on this visual aspect. Let us know! We would love to hear your ideas.

PS. Work on the new UI is in the final stretch! We present its refreshed version from the main game level below. However, we will dedicate a separate, extensive post to the new UI!

Neutral state of the district + HUD

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053691/ffa80de98e6c9f8de8c539c62c819afe43814683.jpg


We’re continuously fine-tuning the balance
ensuring the cities feel vibrant and full of life without overwhelming the player visually.

We would love to hear your thoughts!

 👉 How do you feel about the way fan presence changes the city?
 👉 What details would you like to see added in the future?

Let us know in the comments — your ideas help us shape COPA CITY into a true football experience!

notes.title: Master the balance in Copa City - Devlog #3
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053691/054c1430001ecd6d0fe9f401dd1abb3809a3bc15.png
Time and Space in Copa City – Always Limited
One of the main elements creating the game’s atmosphere is its limited time in a single loop. Players race against a predefined deadline, just like in real life—a football match date that cannot be postponed. Regardless of the player's actions, the time available to organize all aspects is fixed in advance.

At the same time, depending on the map, the "space" available to meet fan needs by building essential infrastructure varies, leading to different approaches to planning the construction of individual facilities.

[previewyoutube=J3Cw1TjRy3M;full][/previewyoutube]

Fan Needs and Growing Numbers – The Challenge of Balancing All
As we mentioned earlier, fan needs are a key aspect of balance and the central focus of the player. We categorized these needs into four groups:

 Safety
 Accommodation
 Entertainment
 Food

Additionally, due to the demographic division of fans into three types, players will experience differences in need priorities—some fans will require better lodging, while others will demand more entertainment.

With the ever-growing influx of fans in the game, each club's needs are balanced in such a way as to represent a different structure and gameplay style. Players must adapt their strategies to achieve the desired outcomes.

Long- and Medium-Term Goals – Synchronization with the Football World
The essence of Copa City, beyond organizing match day, is immersion in the organizational rituals and customs surrounding this event. We want the goals achieved by the player to directly correspond with the football world, ensuring that players feel they are playing a football-themed game at every level.

Setting medium-term goals for players also generates satisfaction over shorter intervals—after all, completing an entire match scenario takes several solid hours of gameplay, which poses challenges for maintaining motivation.

However, organizing a football match is a treasure trove of events, which we use in the game as "dynamic bonuses," or medium-term objectives. For example, having teams arrive at hotels designated and prepared by the player. Seeing club buses parked at assigned hotels will undoubtedly immerse players in the football festival atmosphere, as this is one of the iconic scenes at such events.

The First Whistle – The Main Objective in Copa City
Of course, regardless of the above, the player's primary goal is to ensure the match can take place. To achieve this, a series of conditions must be met, including but not limited to:

 Proper stadium preparation levels for the match
 A specified number of fans in the city
 Meeting fan needs to a certain degree
 Completing specific points on the organizer's roadmap

These elements combine to form the main goal—completing the game’s primary loop and starting the match on the stadium field.

Summary
To summarize, building long-term player engagement in Copa City is key to achieving satisfaction in the gameplay. As mentioned above, we achieve this by rewarding players not only for the long-term goal of successfully organizing the city, stadium, and fans to allow the match and teams to take the field but also for smaller milestones like the arrival of team buses in the city or transporting teams to pre-match training sessions.

We believe this approach will give players the sense that organizing a match is not just about reaching the first whistle but a complex process that delivers satisfaction from managing various levels of challenges.

notes.title: New pre-beta gameplay trailer revealed at PC Gaming Show
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053691/8daf021902ef9c9f02e2dd11d7727b454cd9c8e5.png

We are thrilled to share a major milestone for Copa City! During the prestigious PC Gaming Show, we unveiled our brand-new gameplay trailer, showcasing the incredible progress we’ve made since announcing the game.

[previewyoutube=B8PKb8r3OWI;full][/previewyoutube]

“Our goal has always been to capture the electrifying energy that engulfs a city before a major football event,” said Anna Szamowska, our CMO at Triple Espresso. “This new trailer not only reflects the immense progress we’ve made but also showcases the depth and excitement you can expect when you step into the shoes of a host.”

What’s New in Copa City?
Our latest trailer reveals a host of exciting updates that bring Copa City to life:
Comprehensive Stadium Preparation: From basic customization, we’ve introduced a five-level progression system with clear milestones and permanent achievements.
Enhanced City Visualization: Fan activities, club colors, and district control are now dynamically represented, making the city a vibrant and ever-changing environment.
Advanced City Buildings System: Food trucks and small hotels have evolved into powerful structures that level up based on surrounding infrastructure, offering strategic bonuses to your city.
Replayability Like Never Before: Randomized city layouts, variable fan arrivals, and dynamic quest systems ensure that no two games are ever the same.

Looking Ahead
This past year has been an incredible journey. Through countless hours of development, closed playtests, and listening to your feedback, we’ve been refining every aspect of Copa City to deliver the most immersive football city-building experience possible.
And this is just the beginning! We’re working on exciting new features, including more clubs, a new city, and stunning stadiums that will take the gameplay to the next level. Our commitment to delivering a fresh, engaging, and strategic football experience remains stronger than ever.
We can’t wait for you to see how far we’ve come. Watch the trailer now, and join us in creating the ultimate celebration of football!

notes.title: What Are Clubs in Copa City? Devlog #1
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053691/23857936b12681857b95ad4425966fdb8cd3d5f2.jpg
One of the most important elements in Copa City is football club fans. The gameplay revolves around them. To adapt this concept to a tycoon game, we had to create a unique approach—a matrix that allows us to present the fans of a given club in a way that highlights the significant differences between them.

Everything Starts with Needs
Copa City is a tycoon game that revolves around the needs of the fans. Everything starts from there. When designing the system of needs, we divided them into four main areas:
• Need for food
• Need for accommodation
• Need for safety
• Need for entertainment (which we call the need for a football festival)

The expectations of the fans in the game are built around these four needs. The player's task is to adapt the city's infrastructure to meet these expectations. Importantly, each club will have a different way of realizing these needs—some will require better hotel facilities, while others will demand higher security levels at events—this will influence the player's strategy during gameplay.
Additionally, the needs of both clubs affect each other, meaning that each match-up will require a different approach to gameplay and strategy.

Demographics of the Fan Base – The Basis of Balance
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053691/4613ea89b77e081fa18037a447ef99db8daf1808.png
Another very important aspect of the game is the demographic structure of the fan base. To add depth to the game, we divided the fans coming to the city into three main categories:
• Fans
• Ultras
• Family supporters

Each of these groups focuses on different types of needs, as mentioned earlier, adding further depth to the gameplay. Depending on the club, the player must not only manage the "needs of the club" but also the needs of the various groups coming to the city.
For example, ultras will be a group of fans for whom identification with the club and the football festival atmosphere are the most important, while family supporters will prioritize providing attractions for children and ensuring a high level of safety in the city.

The demographic structure of each club is also different, adding another element that distinguishes clubs from each other. All differences between clubs are based on analyses of the behavior of fans of specific clubs, their preferences, and the priorities of different demographic groups. At Triple Espresso, we work with a scientist who holds a PhD in this field, specifically in the behavior of football fans 😊

Thanks to these aspects, choosing any club for a match will present a different organizational challenge, which is intended to make the gameplay unique in specific match-ups of particular clubs and cities.

Visual Component – A Sense of Completeness in Representing the Club in the Game
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45053691/72228caaa59594742a6b99c5ffcc16ec38e6eba9.png
The visual representation of clubs in the game is a major challenge for us, so we approached it very thoroughly.
At Triple Espresso, in addition to our Art Director who ensures the visual consistency of the game, we also employ people who have worked on the visual representation of the biggest football club in Poland (from which country we originate). These individuals form a team that ensures all elements related to club branding and characteristic visual elements perfectly reflect the club and fan realities. We believe that club heraldry and symbols are among the most important values in the fan community—hence our very detailed approach to this topic.

Thank you for reading this text. We hope to see you in future articles where we will describe more elements of Copa City in detail. We warmly invite you to add the game to your wishlist!
